=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:24-28 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The pr-dependency-released clause in the job `if:` predicate now ends `')) ||` instead of `'))) ||`, so its outer `(github.event_name == 'issue_comment' ...` group is never closed when the new partial-delivery-restart clause is added.
  WHY: actionlint reports `.github/workflows/clarify.yml:24:2117: unexpected end of input while parsing closing ')'`, and GitHub cannot evaluate the job `if:`, so the reusable clarify job fails for every issue and comment.
- .github/workflows/internal-clarify.yml:17-20 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: This repo's clarify wrapper predicate has the same missing closing parenthesis at line 20 (`...pr-dependency-released:"')) ||`).
  WHY: actionlint reports `internal-clarify.yml:17:2117 unexpected end of input`, so the internal clarify wrapper fails at startup and clarify does not run in this repository.
- workflow-templates/ai-clarify.yml:17-20 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The consumer template predicate has the same missing closing parenthesis at line 20.
  WHY: actionlint reports `ai-clarify.yml:17:2117`, so after the next workflow or stable sync every consumer's AI Clarify wrapper has an `if:` that GitHub cannot parse, and clarify stops in every consumer repo.
- README.md:515-516, 1479-1480 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Both documented wrapper-predicate examples end `...pr-dependency-released:"')) ||`, with the same unbalanced parentheses.
  WHY: A wrapper copied from the README does not parse, and the `tests/test_phase_wrapper_predicate_contract.py` predicate tests are coupled to these examples, so the README must be fixed together with the three workflows. Severity disagreement: anthropic and minimax rated MAJOR, qwen rated BLOCKER, and luna included it in a BLOCKER finding; the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:651-773 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The inline `run:` body of the "Decide clarify route" step contains `${{ }}` expressions, and the added `_rel_expected_partial`/`_rel_gate` lines and the extended jq replay check push it to 18,741 characters, over the 18,000-character guard.
  WHY: `tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py::test_interpolated_run_bodies_below_expression_guard` fails in CI job tests-promote-stall-and-review (`job=clarify step=Decide clarify route length=18,741`), and GitHub rejects such bodies at about 21,000 characters. The suggested fix is to move the `${{ }}` values into `env:` or move the logic into a `scripts/` helper.
- tests/test_issue_pr_status_partial_delivery.py:67-73, 173 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The line-173 assertion looks for `ai:clarification` in the fake `gh` argv, but `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` (scripts/label_helpers.sh:251-253) sends the labels as JSON on stdin via `gh api -X PUT .../labels --input -`, and the FAKE_GH stub never records stdin.
  WHY: CI job tests-heal-plan-and-validation fails with `FAILED ...::test_partial_activation_fix_delivery_keeps_the_issue_open - assert False`. The production code is correct; the stub should record `sys.stdin.read()` or the test should assert on the PUT body. Severity disagreement: anthropic rated MAJOR, while minimax, luna and qwen rated BLOCKER; the highest is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5159-5240 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `close_merged_issues_sweep` visits `merged_pr_candidates` (`| unique | .[]`, ascending PR number) and `break`s on the first partial-delivery candidate, setting `sweep_partial_delivery_reason="partial_delivery"`, so a later full-delivery PR (for example the Phase 2 PR) for the same issue is never considered.
  WHY: If issue_pr_status misses the later full-delivery merge, the sweep logs `outcome=skip reason=partial_delivery` on every tick and never closes or labels the issue. The suggested fix is to `continue` past partial candidates (minimax also asks for the same on the rc=2 `break`).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18573 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_pr_json_is_partial_delivery` never checks that `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` is non-empty; the jq `$repo != ""` gate makes an empty value return 1 ("not partial").
  WHY: In a misconfigured consumer, the sweep would treat every merged PR as a full delivery and close partial-delivery issues, bringing back the #4639 regression. The fail-closed fix is to return 2 first. (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised the same point as a hardening suggestion only.)
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:343-346 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `handle_partial_delivery_merge` GETs `git/ref/heads/ai/issue-<n>`, compares its SHA to `PR_HEAD_SHA`, and then sends an unconditional DELETE that is not bound to that SHA.
  WHY: If the branch advances between the GET and the DELETE, the newer tip and its commits are deleted. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly rejected this finding: the branch is only re-pushed after a full clarify → plan → implement cycle, and the ref DELETE API cannot be bound to a SHA.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:handle_partial_delivery_merge restart_text | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `restart_text` interpolates `${issue}` and is posted via `-f "body=${restart_text}"` without the `sanitize_item` pass.
  WHY: This is defence in depth only; `issue` is currently digit-only, but a future change could inject unescaped text. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected it because only the integer issue number is interpolated.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:5851 | severity=unspecified | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The inline Python check for `ai:orchestrator-managed` in the `if...elif` structure is claimed to classify non-managed issues, or issues whose metadata cannot be read, as "managed".
  WHY: The claimed outcome is that misclassified issues skip partial-delivery handling. The source stated no severity. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes it: a Python failure exits non-zero, which means "not managed", so the claimed outcome is backwards.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:5847-5856 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The inline Python orchestrator-managed check runs with `2>/dev/null` and an outer `||`, and catches only `(OSError, ValueError)`, so uncaught exceptions fail silently.
  WHY: `PARTIAL_DELIVERY_REASON` defaults to "no_block" and the run proceeds with a normal "Closes" body, with no log entry to help an operator diagnose the misclassification.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "A regression test for each path: an issue delivered in part does not lose its remaining gaps, and an issue delivered in full still closes with no re-verification."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_issue_pr_status_partial_delivery.py::test_partial_activation_fix_delivery_keeps_the_issue_open
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The partial-path regression test exists but fails in CI at line 173 because it cannot see the label PUT body sent on stdin, so the regression gate is not enforced. The full-delivery test `test_full_delivery_still_closes_the_issue` passes. The actionlint failures in clarify.yml, internal-clarify.yml and workflow-templates/ai-clarify.yml also mean the clarify restart, the last step of the partial path, cannot trigger on this head.
- requirement: "When an implementation deliberately delivers only part of an issue" includes "a plan with 'Scope-mode' narrower than the issue."
  expected_change_site: prompts/mode-plan.txt and prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt, deferred-scope output rule
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The new rule asks for `## Deferred scope` only when a clarification answer or an `AD-<n>` decision limits scope. It does not cover a plan whose `Scope-mode` alone narrows the issue, and implement treats a missing section as a full delivery, so that case still closes the issue.
- requirement: "A regression test for each path" includes that "an issue delivered in full still closes with no re-verification."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_issue_pr_status_partial_delivery.py, `test_full_delivery_still_closes_the_issue` and `test_activation_fix_merge_skip_is_unchanged`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The full-delivery test verifies closure, and the activation-fix test only checks that the `reason=activation_fix_merge` text exists. Neither runs the activation verification path to assert that a full delivery does not trigger re-verification.
- requirement: "If that belongs in a separate issue, split it out instead of widening this one." / AD-4: "The planner should file it as a separate issue that refers to tele-funtoken-msg-scoring#4607."
  expected_change_site: A separate tracked follow-up issue (in shubhodeep1/coding-workflows) referenced by the PR or its documentation
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR description says the never-clarified sweep is split out, but gives no follow-up issue number or link, and no changed artifact identifies that issue. minimax_minimax-m3 noted the same absence but judged the deferral acceptable and not strictly required.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
